title: Sometimes when I dismiss an alert notification, the alert is not snoozed.
symptom: When dismissing an alert notification, the alert is not snoozed.
cause: The alert was cancelled within the minimum limit of 3 seconds, which is a limit set to prevent apps with Notification Access from programmatically cancelling notifications.
fix: Wait longer than 3 seconds before dismissing the alert notification.
evidence_quote: Because some apps with `Notification Access` are, as far as we can determine, programatically cancelling notifications.
